_comment: Players pinned by fire (#547). The server counts rounds from anyone on another side passing within near_miss_metres of a player's chest (chest_below_eyes under their eyes, so it follows a crouch); each adds per_near_miss to their suppression (0 to 1), which falls by decay_per_second. While it is up their own spread is multiplied by 1 + suppression * spread_penalty. Their own screen darkens at the edges (vignette: max_alpha at full suppression, clear_share of the way from the middle to a corner stays untouched) and shakes briefly on each near miss (shake: degrees at full suppression, seconds; the 'Screen shake under fire' setting turns it off).
